item.title: Prediction markets are breaking the news and becoming their own beat
item.description:
📝 For Knibbs, the beat is interesting not only because of potential future effects of prediction markets but also because of their ties to the past. ” Dustin Gouker, an independent journalist who writes the prediction markets-focused newsletter Event Horizon, got interested in prediction markets because of his history covering fantasy sports and gambling. Gouker frequently gets texts from people within the prediction markets space about things they think he’d be interested in.
